about: Adinath Textiles historically manufactured blended acrylic, worsted, and spun yarn, undertook yarn job work, and traded unstitched textiles from its Bholapur, Ludhiana facility. It discontinued textile operations in FY20 and now primarily earns rental income from leasing vacant factory buildings for warehousing, together with interest and investment income. [1] [2]
